name: 小雨西游Ⅱ (Xiaoyu Xiyou II)
english_name: Light Rain Journey to the West II (Xiaoyu Xiyou II)
english_description: Originally archived under the generic filename "20150716 unknown lib.zip," this is actually the second entry in the "Xiaoyu Xiyou" (Light Rain Journey to the West) engine family, sharing a lineage with this project's sibling snapshots xiaoyuxiyou and xyxyutf8 (confirmed via an identical chinese.c file and shared world data, though a content-hash comparison shows it's not byte-identical to either -- each is a snapshot from a different point in the game's development, not a re-encoding). New characters actually start at Cuixiang Tower in the Aolai Kingdom -- Sun Wukong's own birthplace in the original novel -- not at a Chang'an tavern as an earlier version of this description claimed. From there, players spar safely against a training NPC to gain early levels, apprentice under a martial-arts-hall instructor, and can eventually cross a raft to Chang'an to join the Hundred Flowers Valley sect. Death sends characters to the underworld, landing them in a waystation town with its own "Board Between Life and Death" bulletin board before reviving them with a stat penalty.
